func TestTeleportProxyPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	client, server := net.Pipe()
	defer client.Close()
	defer server.Close()

	go func() {
		_, _ = client.Write([]byte(\"Teleport-Proxy {\\\"ClientAddr\\\":\\\"203.0.113.7:4567\\\"}\\x00SSH-2.0-test\\r\\n\"))
	}()

	conn, err := detect(server, false)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, ProtoSSH, conn.Protocol())
	require.Equal(t, \"203.0.113.7:4567\", conn.RemoteAddr().String())
	firstSSHLine := make([]byte, len(\"SSH-2.0-test\\r\\n\"))
	_, err = io.ReadFull(conn, firstSSHLine)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, \"SSH-2.0-test\\r\\n\", string(firstSSHLine))
}

func TestTeleportProxyPrefixWithoutClientAddr(t *testing.T) {
	client, server := net.Pipe()
	defer client.Close()
	defer server.Close()

	go func() {
		_, _ = client.Write([]byte(\"Teleport-Proxy {}\\x00SSH-2.0-test\\r\\n\"))
	}()

	conn, err := detect(server, false)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, ProtoSSH, conn.Protocol())
	require.Equal(t, server.RemoteAddr(), conn.RemoteAddr())
}
EOF

item.text:
Implemented `Teleport-Proxy` frame handling in the SSH multiplexer. It consumes the JSON payload and null terminator, classifies the following traffic normally, and exposes `ClientAddr` through `RemoteAddr()` when present. Connections without that field keep their socket address.

Added tests for both address cases and for preserving the initial SSH identification line. `go test ./lib/multiplexer` passes.
